about: Named viewpoints for tools/review/render.py. Roblox coordinates in studs (Y up; the game's North is +Z, so +X is West). pos = camera, look = point looked at, fov = VERTICAL field of view in degrees (Roblox Camera.FieldOfView convention; Roblox default 70). aboveGround: pos.y and look.y are heights above the terrain (World/Height) under each point. groups: what is drawn (town = Workspace.Town parts, terrain = boot terrain heightfield + river water, editor_ground = build/EditorGround.rbxm, lineup / lineup_ground = placeholder puppets on a 1-stud checker). up: optional camera up vector (used for straight-down views). debug views render only with --debug.

views.name: a_street_level
views.desc: Eye height 5 st (human head) on the east sidewalk of rd_004 (x = -450), looking north past outer homes 01/02 (left) and 00 (right).

views.name: b_squirrel_eye
views.desc: Squirrel eye 0.8 st above the road surface on rd_001 (x = 0), looking north toward the old-town core trees (Tree_550 at x 25 z -267, Tree_220 / Tree_231 at the core).

views.name: c_tree_25
views.desc: Tree_283 (trunk foot about x -364 z -299, 56 x 76 x 65 st) from 25 st away, eye 5 st, sun behind the camera.

views.name: d_poles_lamps
views.desc: On the south sidewalk of rd_010 (z = 0) looking east (-X): telephone poles at z -41.2 on the right, street lamps along the kerbs and sidewalks.

views.name: e1_aerial_300
views.desc: Oblique aerial 300 st above the ground over the old-town core (looking from the sun side).

views.name: e2_top_300
views.desc: Straight down from 300 st above the central intersection, North (+Z) up, so +X (West) is on the LEFT like town_map.svg.

views.name: e3_overview_top
views.desc: Whole town straight down from 3600 st, North up (compare with assets/placeholders/town_map.svg).

views.name: f1_lineup_all
views.desc: Placeholder puppets side by side on a 1-stud checker, front three-quarter (authored facing -Z toward the camera).

views.name: f2_lineup_small
views.desc: Close-up of squirrel, rodent and fox (1-stud checker).

views.name: f3_lineup_rear
views.desc: The lineup from behind (+Z) three-quarter: tails, backs, rear lights.

views.name: g_editor_view
views.desc: What Studio's EDITOR shows: the town without terrain plus build/EditorGround.rbxm (the server swaps it for terrain at boot).

views.name: h_quay_bridge
views.desc: The quay: stone bridge over the river at x 2125 z 0, bridge towers, embankment (from the west bank, looking east toward -X).

views.name: i_hospital
views.desc: Hospital front (hospital_main x -890 z 882.5, porte cochere, ambulance bay) from the south-west.

views.name: k_gas_canopy
views.desc: East fuel canopy (east_fuel_canopy x 1190 z 157.5) and fuel market at eye height.

views.name: axes_check
views.desc: Orientation test: red +X, green +Y, blue +Z bars from the origin, a WedgePart at (-4,1,0) (tall face at its +Z), a cylinder at (0,1,-5) (axis X) and a ball at (-4,1,-5). From (+X,+Y,+Z) a correct render shows red going down-RIGHT and blue going down-LEFT.
